name: -8 AN Cap / Blockoff
title: -8 AN Cap / Blockoff
description:
The -8 AN Cap / Blockoff is engineered for demanding high-performance automotive fluid systems. ColorFittings AN Caps are precision CNC-machined to securely seal unused AN ports, fittings, and lines in fuel, oil, coolant, brake, transmission, and power steering systems. Designed with a true 37-degree AN flare seat, these caps provide a clean, leak-free solution for closing off unused connections during maintenance, fabrication, or custom plumbing projects.

Technical Specifications:
• Origin: Precision CNC-machined in the USA.
• Material & Finish: 6061-T6 Billet Aluminum with an anodized finish for maximum corrosion resistance.
